blocks.h2: Shower Problems We Fix in Elgin
blocks.intro: Most of these come from inside the valve:

tiles.h3: Drips From the Head or Spout

tiles.body: No pressure balancing, or a worn balancing cartridge.
A clogged head, a failing cartridge or old supply pipe.
A leaking valve body or a loose connection. Look for stains on the ceiling below.

blocks.intro: Elgin bathrooms span more than a century.

items.body: Some historic homes still have clawfoot tubs with exposed shower risers. We repair and replace those fittings.
Separate hot and cold handles are common in older bathrooms. Parts can be hard to find, and a single-handle valve may be the better fix.
In 1990s and 2000s homes, the original cartridges are often worn. A cartridge swap usually brings them back.

items.h3: Showers Added in Old Attics and Porches
items.body: Some older Elgin homes got bathrooms in converted attics or enclosed porches. Those lines can be long and exposed to cold, so we check them closely.

blocks.h2: Shower Repair Questions From Elgin Homeowners

items.q: Can you fix a shower without removing tile?
items.preview: Usually. Most repairs go through the trim.
items.answer: Usually. Cartridges and washers come out through the trim opening. A full valve replacement may need a small access panel.

items.q: Why does my shower go cold when someone uses water?
items.answer: When another fixture pulls cold water, a valve without pressure balancing lets the shower swing hot. A pressure-balancing valve fixes it.

items.q: Can you work on a clawfoot tub shower?
items.preview: Yes. We repair and replace exposed fittings.
items.answer: Yes. We repair and replace exposed risers, diverters and tub fillers on clawfoot setups.

items.q: Why is my shower pressure low?
items.preview: Start with the showerhead. Then the cartridge or pipe.
items.answer: Mineral buildup in the showerhead is the most common cause. If a new head doesn't help, the cartridge or the supply pipe is likely the issue.

items.q: Can you replace a tub spout or diverter?
items.answer: Yes. A spout that drips while the shower runs or a diverter that won't send water to the head is a quick fix.

items.q: How much does shower repair cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on the valve and parts. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the valve, the parts and access. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
